description: Integration test that skips without TEST_DATABASE_URL.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+package propose
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"os"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
+)
+
+func TestRunStatsColumn(t *testing.T) {
+	url := os.Getenv("TEST_DATABASE_URL")
+	if url == "" {
+		t.Skip("TEST_DATABASE_URL not set")
+	}
+	pool, err := pgxpool.New(context.Background(), url)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer pool.Close()
+}
